_schema_note: An index of build items and the findings they raised — a cache, never an authority: git and GitHub own what was built and merged. Narrative (decision logs, evidence, round-by-round critique) goes in the PR body or the item's ref.md, never here. items[]: { id, tier, level, node, status, pr_url, review_url, handover_issue, rounds, risk_tier, det_gate, visual, pr_error? }, status one of queued | built | ready-for-review | merged | handover | needs-human | needs-re-ref | deferred | closed. findings[]: { id (FND-NNN or "UNALLOCATED"), item, class, severity, status, summary, disposition }. `npm run check:state` checks it.
